Since precipitate is white and remains after adding NH3 (no mention of dissolving), likely Al3+ or Zn2+ (but Zn would dissolve in excess NH3). Since we used equal volumes, maybe not excess. Could be Al3+. Also Ca2+ forms no precipitate with NH3. So candidate Al3+.
